sources.title: Visa Information For Foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry nationality table uses East Timor, makes ordinary passports visa-subject, and directly provides a 30-day single-entry eVisa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: East Timor citizens may get their 30 days single entry e-Visas via the web site www.evisa.gov.tr.

policies.title: Timorese ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry nationality table directly permits East Timor citizens to obtain a 30-day single-entry eVisa before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Timor-Leste passport holder travelling for tourism or commerce.
The eVisa is obtained electronically before travel and permits a 30-day single entry.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
